skill.summary: AI image upscaling using Real-ESRGAN. 2x/3x/4x super-resolution for photos and general images. $0.10 USDC via x402.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of ntriq-x402-image-upscale.
- Provides AI-powered image upscaling using Real-ESRGAN on Apple M4 GPU.
- Supports 2x, 3x, or 4x super-resolution for jpg, png, and webp images.
- Offers both general and photo-optimized modes.
- Pricing: $0.10 USDC per image via x402 payment protocol.
